title: 5 Q’s for Brandon Contino, Co-founder and CEO of Four Growers
summary: The Center for Data Innovation spoke with Brandon Contino, co-founder and CEO of Four Growers, an agricultural robotics company based in Pennsylvania. Contino explained how automation can boost productivity, reduce operational costs, and promote sustainability in greenhouses.
